user.title: OPNsense - Connection
user.description:
Enter the connection details for your OPNsense firewall.

Generate the API key in OPNsense: System → Access → Users → ApiKeys tab.

data_description.verify_ssl: Disable if your OPNsense uses a self-signed certificate (the default case).

wan.title: OPNsense - WAN interface
wan.description: Choose the interface to monitor as WAN (throughput, public IP, connectivity). Auto-detection works for most setups.

reauth_confirm.title: OPNsense - Re-authentication
reauth_confirm.description: Your API key was rejected by OPNsense. Enter valid credentials to restore the connection.

reconfigure.title: OPNsense - Reconfigure
reconfigure.description: Update the connection settings for this firewall.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the firewall. Check the IP/port and that HA can reach OPNsense.
error.insufficient_privileges: The API user lacks the required privileges. See the documentation for the minimal privilege list.

abort.already_configured: This OPNsense firewall is already configured.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: Those credentials belong to a different OPNsense firewall than the one being configured.

init.title: OPNsense
init.description: What do you want to configure?

refresh.title: Refresh
refresh.description: Data arrives at three speeds: real-time (pushed by OPNsense), fast and slow.

data_description.realtime: WAN throughput and CPU % continuously pushed by OPNsense (no extra API privilege).
data_description.live_publish: How often Home Assistant shows real-time values. Shorter = livelier, more database writes.
data_description.fast_interval: WAN state, public IPs, latency, packet loss, VPN tunnels, temperatures.
data_description.top_interval: Each refresh asks OPNsense for a 2 s capture: shorter = more responsive, a bit more load on the firewall.
data_description.wan_interface: Auto = the WAN carrying the default route (follows failovers). Used for the public IP and top destinations.
data_description.wan_exclude: Links detected from their upstream gateway. An ignored link gets no entities and no alerts.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: The OPNsense sidebar dashboard. Changing the theme regenerates it right away (manual edits are replaced).

data_description.create_dashboard: Turn off to manage your own dashboard without it being overwritten.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Alerts sent by the integration itself, no automation to write.

data_description.notify_targets: While the WAN is down a push cannot leave your home (except local push on your home Wi-Fi): the "WAN restored" message always gets through, with the outage duration.
data_description.notify_persistent: Shown in the Home Assistant bell, even without internet.

options.graphite: Graphite · calm and matte, one bright accent
options.aurore: Aurora · gradient glows and soft glass
options.cockpit: Cockpit · instruments, big figures, amber and cyan

options.wan: WAN down / restored, multi-WAN failover (with duration)
